function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT period, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(revenue_cad) AS total_rev FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line WHERE period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09') GROUP BY period ORDER BY period","purpose":"Compare total units sold and revenue between Aug and Sep 2026"}
